label: The canonical parent-hub rule is folder == packetSkillName == [hub-prefix]-<mode> for workflow modes, so workflow modes keep the prefix; mcp-browser-use has prefix mcp, giving mcp-<mode> folders.

parent-skill-check 3d-name soft-fails an ungrandfathered folder/name mismatch and a stale grandfatheredFolderMismatch:true flag, and requires packet SKILL.md frontmatter name == packetSkillName; it neither requires nor forbids the mcp- prefix, ruling out the hybrid bare-folder/prefixed-name option.

Current ids already satisfy the canonical rule: Chrome and Aside each have workflowMode == packet == packetSkillName ('mcp-chrome-devtools' / 'mcp-aside-devtools') with grandfatheredFolderMismatch:false, so keeping the prefix is the zero-rename option.
The parent spec's bare names 'bladebro, aside and chrome-devtools' are the <mode> nouns, not full ids; spec.md:146 leaves the prefix decision to KQ5 and 004 defers the Bladebro folder name to KQ5.

Decision: keep the mcp- prefix. Folder / workflowMode / packetSkillName are mcp-chrome-devtools, mcp-aside-devtools, and new mcp-bladebro, with folder == packetSkillName and grandfatheredFolderMismatch:false for each.

Blast-radius consequence: with ids unchanged the KQ4 hand-edit set needs only path-prefix relocation (mcp-tooling/ to mcp-browser-use/); the byte-identical _utils.sh test coupling, doctor guard skill_dir values and advisor route-label resolution still need re-pointing/verification in 005.
KQ3's folder == packetSkillName invariant is preserved with the strings now filled in; no amendment to the proposed registry shape is needed.
